This implies that (-)-beta-Curcumene may act as a competitive inhibitor of Fumarprotocetraric Acid, thereby modulating the activity of the EDD domain protein. The integration of these relationships highlights a potential regulatory role for (-)-beta-Curcumene in the metabolic pathway involving Aconitate hydratase, mitochondrial.
